query: SELECT c.name as company, cat.name as category, COUNT(p.id) as products, ROUND(SUM(p.currentStock),2) as totalStock, ROUND(SUM(p.currentStock * p.avgCost),2) as stockValue FROM products p INNER JOIN categories cat ON p.categoryId = cat.id INNER JOIN companies c ON p.companyId = c.id WHERE p.active = 1 AND (p.isComposite = 0 OR p.isComposite IS NULL) AND p.currentStock > 0 GROUP BY c.name, cat.name ORDER BY c.name, cat.name
